name: @nredd/pi-session-kit
description: Session-scoped pi tools and commands, offline cross-machine usage stats and a portable privacy-only stats CLI. No daemon.
author: nredd

scripts.test: npm run build:stats-export && node ../../scripts/run-vitest.ts node --coverage --exclude test/scenarios/home-injection.test.ts && node ../../scripts/run-vitest.ts node test/scenarios/home-injection.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false
scripts.test:bun: node ../../scripts/run-vitest.ts bun --exclude test/scenarios/home-injection.test.ts && node ../../scripts/run-vitest.ts bun test/scenarios/home-injection.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:bun
